final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM hand_counts), step3 AS (SELECT h.batting_hand, h.record_count, CAST(h.record_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM hand_counts AS h CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS mean_count FROM step3) SELECT s.batting_hand, s.record_count, s.share, CAST(s.record_count AS REAL) / a.mean_count FROM step3 AS s CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE a.mean_count IS NOT NULL
